title: The Ahom Political System: An Enquiry Into the State Formation Process In Medieval Assam: 1228-1714
author: Dr. Amalendu Guha
description: Foundational socio-historical treatise analyzing the state formation process in medieval Upper Assam under the Tai Ahom polity. Examines the integration of Tai customary governance, wet-rice hydraulic agriculture, paik labor organization, and kinship alliances with indigenous Tibeto-Burman populations.
